picks.editorial_note: DARPA and the U.S. Air Force successfully flew an AI agent autonomously controlling an F-16, a landmark milestone toward scalable autonomous air combat with major defense and technical significance.
picks.title: DARPA and U.S. Air Force fly AI-controlled F-16, paving the way for autonomous air combat

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab detailed the DOE's American Science Cloud, a federated national HPC/data infrastructure under the Genesis Mission designed to unify resources across labs and accelerate AI-driven scientific discovery at national scale.
picks.title: How the Genesis Mission’s American Science Cloud Advances Innovation

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's Whittle Laboratory convened government, industry, and research leaders to chart an AI-driven industrial strategy for UK aerospace, energy, and defence — a policy-shaping summit with major financial stakes.
picks.title: Landmark summit at Cambridge's new Whittle Laboratory aims to reignite Britain's industrial engine in aerospace, energy and defence

picks.editorial_note: UCSF Health launched Converge, an AI accelerator with venture firms Kleiner Perkins and Doerr Capital that embeds startups directly in a live clinical environment — a novel funding and partnership model for healthcare AI.
picks.title: UCSF Health Partners to Launch New Model to Build Healthcare AI

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn University signed an MoU with NVIDIA and launched the Chula AI Center, a significant academia-industry partnership advancing AI research and talent development in Southeast Asia.
picks.title: จุฬาฯ จัดงาน CU × NVAITC Symposium 2026 ลงนาม MoU เปิดตัว Chula AI Center

picks.editorial_note: A major philanthropic gift from alumnus Parker Petit establishes Georgia Tech's new AI-Driven Health Innovation Center, a substantial funding commitment aimed at applying AI to disease prediction and treatment.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives Commitment to Launch New AI-Driven Health Innovation Center

picks.editorial_note: WashU Medicine's BeaconPredict, an AI tool that predicts dangerous post-stroke brain swelling, earned FDA Breakthrough Device designation — a concrete regulatory milestone toward real-world clinical deployment.
picks.title: Tool to predict brain swelling earns FDA Breakthrough Device designation

picks.editorial_note: Weill Cornell researchers developed an AI method that maps and scores human bone marrow samples to more precisely diagnose a serious blood cancer, a meaningful advance in AI-assisted diagnostics.
picks.title: Mapping Human Bone Marrow Yields New Tool, Insights on Blood Cancer
picks.university: Weill Medical College of Cornell University

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University's GOFLOW system reconstructs high-resolution ocean current patterns from satellite data, revealing previously invisible small-scale currents relevant to climate and ocean science.
picks.title: Seeing the Ocean Like Never Before

picks.editorial_note: The National Academies convened an international workshop and consensus study examining how AI-enabled tools affect biosecurity risk, informing policy on preparedness against novel biological threats.
picks.title: Strengthening Preparedness Against Novel Biological Threat Agents Enabled Through Artificial Intelligence and Other Emerging Technologies
